name: ogbn-products: Amazon Product Co-purchasing Network
description: The ogbn-products dataset is an undirected, unweighted graph representing an Amazon product co-purchasing network from the Open Graph Benchmark (OGB). Nodes represent individual products sold on Amazon (2,449,029 nodes), and edges represent products frequently purchased together (61,859,140 edges). Each node features a 100-dimensional feature vector extracted from text descriptions via Bag-of-Words and PCA. The task is to predict the top-level product category across 47 classes with realistic sales-rank out-of-distribution splits.
